data.name: PageTitle
data.comment: Title of the browser tab on the Add photos page.

data.name: Title
data.comment: Heading of the Add photos page.

data.name: EntryLabel
data.comment: Labelled button on the Plants page, and the label of the round camera button, that opens the Add photos page.

data.name: EmptyText
data.value: Photos from your gallery can go to a plant or propagation from here. Choose them, then pick where they belong.
data.comment: Empty state on the Add photos page when no photos are waiting.

data.name: ChooseFromGallery
data.comment: Button that opens the phone's gallery to choose photos.

data.name: ShareMenuNote
data.value: When the app is installed from Chrome, Edge or Samsung Internet, it also shows up in your phone's share menu. {0}
data.comment: Small line under the empty state. {0} is the link to the Help page.

data.name: SharePartial
data.value: Some of the shared photos couldn't be kept here, probably because the device is short of space. They are still in your gallery.
data.comment: Alert at the top of the Add photos page when the share menu handed over photos that could not all be stored.

data.name: ShareMenuNoteLink
data.comment: Link text at the end of the share menu note, {0} in it.

data.name: Waiting_One
data.comment: Heading over the waiting photos. {0} is the number, here exactly one.

data.name: Waiting_Other
data.comment: Heading over the waiting photos. {0} is the number.

data.name: ChooseMore
data.comment: Outline button that adds more photos to the waiting ones.

data.name: TileLabel
data.comment: Name of a waiting photo for screen readers. {0} is its place in the list.

data.name: Loading
data.comment: Shown while the waiting photos are read.

data.name: WhereLabel
data.comment: Label over the list of plants and propagations the photos can go to.

data.name: SearchPlaceholder
data.comment: Placeholder and label of the search field above the list of destinations.

data.name: NewPlant
data.comment: Outline button that starts a new plant with the ticked photos.

data.name: NewPropagation
data.comment: Outline button that starts a new propagation with the ticked photos.

data.name: KindPlant
data.comment: Small line under a name in the list of destinations.

data.name: KindPropagation
data.comment: Small line under a name in the list of destinations.

data.name: NoDestinations
data.value: You have no plants or propagations to send them to yet. Start one with the buttons above and the ticked photos come along.
data.comment: Empty state in the list of destinations when there is nothing to send photos to.

data.name: NoMatch
data.value: Nothing matches that. Clear the search, or start a new plant or propagation with the ticked photos.
data.comment: Empty state in the list of destinations when the search finds nothing.

data.name: Add_None
data.comment: Primary button when no photo is ticked or no destination is chosen.

data.name: Add_One
data.comment: Primary button. {0} is the number of ticked photos, here exactly one.

data.name: Add_Other
data.comment: Primary button. {0} is the number of ticked photos.

data.name: Adding
data.comment: Shown while the ticked photos are saved.

data.name: Added_One
data.comment: Status after adding. {0} is the number, here exactly one. {1} is the name of the plant or propagation, as a link.

data.name: Added_Other
data.comment: Status after adding. {0} is the number. {1} is the name of the plant or propagation, as a link.

data.name: AllSorted
data.comment: Heading when no photos are waiting any more after sending them.

data.name: GoToSubject
data.comment: Link to the plant or propagation the photos were added to. {0} is its name.

data.name: GoToToday
data.comment: Link to the Today page.

data.name: Discard
data.comment: Link style button that takes the ticked photos off the waiting list.

data.name: DiscardConfirm_One
data.value: Take the ticked photo off this list? The original is still in your gallery.
data.comment: Asked before discarding. Exactly one photo is ticked.

data.name: DiscardConfirm_Other
data.value: Take the {0} ticked photos off this list? The originals are still in your gallery.
data.comment: Asked before discarding. {0} is the number of ticked photos.

data.name: ReadFailed
data.comment: Error when the waiting photos can't be read. {0} is the reason.

data.name: ChooseFailed
data.comment: Error when the browser can't store the chosen photos. {0} is the reason.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: Couldn't add the photos ({0}). They are still waiting.
data.comment: Error when saving to a plant fails. {0} is the reason. Nothing was lost.

data.name: DiscardFailed
data.comment: Error when discarding fails. {0} is the reason.

data.name: TodayWaiting_One
data.comment: Reminder on Today. {0} is the number of photos waiting, here exactly one.

data.name: TodayWaiting_Other
data.comment: Reminder on Today. {0} is the number of photos waiting.

data.name: TodaySort
data.comment: Button on the reminder on Today that opens the Add photos page.
